description:
The 72-Hour Home explores what happens to an ordinary American house when the systems behind it stop working.

Why can a power outage flood a basement? How long will a freezer stay cold? And what happens to your pipes when the heat goes out in winter?

Through timelines, familiar home scenarios, and clear explanations, we explore electricity, heating, plumbing, drainage, refrigeration, and backup power. Each video connects a part of your home to the hidden system it depends on—and what can happen when that system fails.

Discover what keeps your house working, which warning signs matter, and how to limit damage when something stops.

Subscribe for a closer look at the home you know—and the systems you may have overlooked.
